meta.title: TAMBO – Karolína Pištěková
meta.description: An authentic story of a woman who fell apart – so she would no longer have to live a lie. You don't read it with your head. You read it with your body.

hero.desc: TAMBO is a manifesto of a woman who refuses to fulfill other's expectations. It's a direct path to the depths where your true self awaits.

hook.desc: “TAMBO is a guide to your own inner jungle. A silent mirror placed before your soul when it's no longer possible to lie to yourself.”

steps.title: The Fall
steps.desc: That moment deep in the night when you realize your entire life so far was just a false, safe facade.

steps.title: The Shame
steps.desc: The shame that burns your throat until you find the courage to cry it out and stop apologizing for feeling more than others.

steps.title: The Return
steps.desc: Rebirth into your wild, untamed essence. Coming home, to your body and your true wisdom.

author.quote: “I don't write to be liked. I write to bear my own truth.”
author.desc1: TAMBO is a manifesto about the journey from noisy strip clubs to the silence of the Peruvian jungle. Karolína doesn't lead you where it's safe, but where you will truly feel alive.
author.desc2: Today she guides women who are putting down the 'good girl' mask. She helps them discover their true power — one that might unsettle those around them, but which the world desperately needs.

footer.desc: An authentic manifesto about courage and truth. The first book by Karolína Pištěková.
